title: Badge Gun
original_lyrics:
[verse]
"Badge & Gun" (By: John Mayer) --
Give me my badge and gun / Give me the road that I may run
Give me that peaceful-wandering free I used to know
I've waited all I can / But I'm just not patient man
And I've been hiding here for seven months or so
Hand me down my coat and hat / And grab the winter one at that
You never know how long I'll be away
Give me my badge and gun / Give me the songs that I once sung
Give me those jet-black, kick-back, lay down nights alone
This house is safe and warm / But I was made to chase the storm
Taking the whole world on with big ol' empty arms
Tell my friends I tried my best / That one day I just up and left
They probably saw it coming anyway
Oohs: , , , , , , , , ,
The lock is on the silver door / I can't remember what it's for
I ain't been down those stairs in oh so long
Give me my badge and gun / Give me the road that I must run
Give me that peaceful-wandering free I used to know
The copy of your key is hanging where it used to be
Good as you've always been to me
The life I need to lead
Is somewhere out there calling over those hills END
